"X has become a much more powerful force in driving tech investor sentiment over the past few years. Honestly, besides Bloomberg, it’s my most important resource. I literally started a new section of my daily email a few weeks ago called SchilskyX where I screenshot and respond to Tweets. It’s that important. One important issue to note: the FinTwit community of influencers is VERY small. We’re talking less than 50 people that drive a preponderance of sentiment.
